name: Favourite Tools
description: Eight light prompts about the tools, habits and little setups you like working with.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight light prompts about the tools and setups you like, with optional notes, on Reflection Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Follow whichever prompt you like.
howToPlay: Read the prompt and see where your mind goes.
If you like, type a few words in the notes box. They stay on this device.
Press Next for another prompt, or Back to return.
tips: Notes are optional and can be as short as one word. Clear them any time.
